name: How much does it cost to replace a kitchen floor when I do not know what is under it?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace a kitchen floor when I do not know what is under it?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total price depends on kitchen size, material, demolition, subfloor repairs, disposal, transitions, appliance handling, and whether cabinets are removed or remain. A reliable estimate should separate the finish material from preparation and related remodeling work. Context: A simple replacement over a sound base can differ substantially from a project involving water damage, leveling, cabinet changes, or flooring that continues into adjacent spaces. Key factors: - Square footage and waste - Removal and disposal - Subfloor or underlayment work - Cabinet and appliance coordination Practical guidance: Request a written scope that identifies assumptions, exclusions, repair allowances, and finish boundaries. Elite Remodeling & Design can evaluate flooring alongside kitchen remodeling decisions so the estimate reflects the full sequence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on square footage, material, demolition, disposal, subfloor repairs, transitions, and cabinet or appliance handling. Ask for a written scope that separates flooring, preparation, and uncertain repair allowances instead of relying on a material-only estimate.
